trends.name: Iran-Israel Conflict Escalation
trends.summary: Despite sustained US-Israeli strikes, 50% of Iran's missile launchers, thousands of drones, and significant coastal defense cruise missiles remain operational. Iran's Revolutionary Guard has threatened attacks on US tech companies. This persistent Iranian military capability is driving energy prices higher, impacting inflation, mortgage rates (up 5 weeks), and airline fuel costs.

trends.name: Energy & Inflation Crisis Impact
trends.summary: Mortgage rates rising for fifth consecutive week tied to Iran war energy costs. Fed's Williams confirms higher energy prices hitting inflation and disposable incomes on both sides of Fed mandate. Airlines raising checked bag fees as fuel climbs. Oil itself emerging as best hedge against oil-based inflation.

trends.name: Turkey Gold Liquidation & Currency Crisis
trends.summary: Turkey dumped 120 tons of gold (~$20B) since Iran war started, including 70 tons in one week—equivalent to 6 years of gold accumulation in 3 weeks. Move aimed to defend lira and fund energy purchases. Raises critical question of who is absorbing this massive gold supply, suggesting potential currency crisis and geopolitical financial stress.

trends.name: Private Credit Fund Redemption Wave
trends.summary: Intensifying investor redemptions from private credit funds as market repricing accelerates. Fed's Williams monitoring closely but doesn't see systemic risk yet. Represents potential liquidity stress for the 'new kings of Wall Street' and could force asset sales into weakening markets.

trends.name: Microsoft-SoftBank $10B AI Expansion
trends.summary: Microsoft planning $10 billion AI push with SoftBank, with Sakura Internet jumping 20% on the news. Microsoft executives touting Copilot sales traction amid ongoing AI adoption uncertainty. Signals major tech investment commitment in Asia-Pacific but reflects market anxiety around AI monetization.

trends.name: US Labor Market Deterioration Signals
trends.summary: Forward-looking data points to rising US unemployment ahead of NFP report. Consumer perception gap on job availability narrowed to 5.8 points (lowest since 2020 pandemic). Fed expects 'low hire, low fire' economy with more modest hiring ahead. Stagflation concerns mounting as economy faces dual headwinds.

trends.name: Trump Administration Policy Volatility
trends.summary: Pam Bondi fired as Attorney General; 56% Polymarket odds Tulsi Gabbard exits by June 30. Trump's 'Dow over 50,000' comments creating sentiment whiplash. Administration announcing up to 100% tariffs on imported drugs with selective exemptions, creating winners/losers uncertainty. Political instability creating trading headwinds.

trends.name: Semiconductor & Tech Supply Chain Shifts
trends.summary: South Korea-France cooperation expanding in AI, semiconductors, and quantum technologies. Microchip showing growth trend improvement after major plunge. Iran's threats against US tech companies ($NVDA, $AAPL) raising geopolitical supply chain risks. Reshuffling of chip supply dynamics away from single-source dependencies.

trends.name: Fed Rate Path & Market Repricing
trends.summary: Market bottomed Monday per Ed Yardeni, but uncertainty on Fed policy direction persists. Williams signals Fed monitoring energy impact on inflation closely, critical to achieving 2% target. Cracks widening in broader stock market as investors reassess rate trajectory amid stagflation risks and energy shocks.

trends.name: Tesla EV Delivery & Profitability Concerns
trends.summary: Tesla stock falls as delivery reports suggest company 'actively sacrificing' EV sales, implying margin pressure or demand concerns. Raises questions about EV profitability in tightening macro environment and competitive pricing pressures.

trends.name: Retail Consumer Price Pressures
trends.summary: Starbucks turnaround moves failed to support stock. Sam's Club hiking membership fees with analysts expecting Costco and BJ's to follow. Airlines raising checked bag fees. Consumer staples and discretionary facing margin squeeze from energy costs and forced to pass costs to already-stressed consumers.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO & Private Market Exits
trends.summary: SpaceX IPO discussion gaining traction with implications for Elon Musk's capital structure and valuation across his portfolio. Represents potential major private market exit and shift in space/defense sector public market participation.
